participants_known.description: All required and optional participants are identified

timezones_resolved.description: Participant time zones are resolved or a blocker is recorded

duration_known.description: Meeting duration is specified before proposing slots

candidate_slots_listed.description: Candidate slots are listed with date, time, timezone, and availability status

invite_send_approved.description: Sending invites or scheduling messages waits for explicit user approval

sent_item_evidence_recorded.description: If an invite or message is sent, final send evidence is recorded

residual_risk: Availability and time zone data can change between slot proposal and sending. Invites, messages, calendar changes, cancellations, and deletions require explicit user approval.
